comment: Hand-labeled synthetic responses used to validate the oracle BEFORE it scores a paid run: twelve items spanning both languages and all four 2x2 states, three per state and six per language. Each label pins four independent calls -- the activation line, the five-element skeleton, the resulting 2x2 state, and skeleton wellformedness -- so a pattern edit that quietly loosens one of them reddens test_oracle.py rather than silently changing what the confirmatory outcome means. Two items are adversarial on purpose: en-skeleton-02 carries all five elements behind a MALFORMED line (round brackets) and an inconsistent 9/3 figure, and pt-neither-02 carries one element name and a valid denominator in an ordinary execution answer. The responses are synthetic; no model produced them, and none was drawn from a run. Frozen: the record hashes this file.
